verdict.rationale: Docs gesture at reporting/analytics ("build automations, segmentation and reports", "flow performance reports", pulling data for dashboards) but never specifically describe per-campaign or per-automation-step metrics like opens, clicks, unsubscribes, or conversions over time. missing for 10: explicit documentation of open/click/unsubscribe/conversion metrics, per-step automation reporting, and time-series/trend views.
